name: guest-start-approved
description: The APPROVE half of the guest session-start gate. The channel attributes org membership (fake: orgScoped), the sender carries no membership stamp — which an attributing channel reads as guest, fail-closed — and holds no agentclass#start_session, so the pipeline creates the session PARKED: no started_by tuple, no runner, and a start_approval card to the platform admins. The background approver, deciding AS the seeded platform admin, clicks Approve; the decision pipe re-checks platform#start_session server-side, decideStartApproval writes the withheld standing and removes the parking marker, the operator unparks, and the runner cold-starts on the guest's original message — no retype. The agent's reply is the proof the whole chain closed.
